english.note: Use this when a liquid falls in drops; it is the straightforward choice for liquid rather than saliva or a ball.
Use 滴 specifically when liquid falls one drop or droplet at a time.

examples.english: A little water continues to dribble from the tap.
examples.traditional: 水喉漏水，啲水一滴一滴咁滴落嚟。
examples.jyutping: seoi2 hau4 lau6 seoi2 di1 seoi2 jat1 dik6 jat1 dik6 gam3 dik6 lok6 lai4

examples.english: I watched water drop from the tap one drop at a time.
examples.traditional: 水喉仲一滴一滴咁滴緊水。
